reason: I already have my morning spot and my drink, and they know my order. Strawberry cheesecake matcha at $8.50 isn't what I want at 7am, and I'm not changing my routine for a $5 Americano I can get anywhere.
objection: $7–8 is a lot for a latte, and dessert drinks with a weekend photo line don't sound fast.
would_change_my_mind: If my regular place closed or got slow, and this one could hand me a good plain latte or Americano in under two minutes, I'd switch.
